{{Quote|I believe it was a ''mutiny'', sir. Quite a brawl, if I may dare to offer an opinion.|[[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]]|<ref name="Darklighter12" />}}
The '''Mutiny on the ''Rand Ecliptic''''' was an insurrection on board the [[Imperial II-class frigate|''Imperial II''-class frigate]] the [[Rand Ecliptic/Legends|''Rand Ecliptic'']] in the [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]]. The mutiny was incited by two cells on board the the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], both trying to defect to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and operating independently of each other. One cell, led by [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]] [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]], sabotaged the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate's]] systems before escaping in [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. In the resulting chaos, the ship's [[Second mate/Legends|second mate]], [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] led another cell in taking command of the bridge, discovering two more rebel cells in the process.

==Background==
[[File:Class_II.jpg|thumb|250px|The [[Rand Ecliptic/Legends|''Rand Ecliptic'']].]]

Two major figures in the mutiny, [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian]] and [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]], were assigned to the [[Rand Ecliptic/Legends|''Rand Ecliptic'']] after their graduation from [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Prefsbelt Fleet Camp]].<ref name="Baron Fel" /> In the academy, they had participated in a group of idealistic cadets idly dreaming about overthrowing the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. An informant sold out the other members of the group to the Academy Commander, but Darklighter and Klivian were not discovered, as they had not participated in the meeting in which the informant was present. Klivian and Darklighter never learned what happened to their friends, but the event cemented their anti-Imperial attitudes and led them to seriously contemplate defection to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> During their time in the academy, Darklighter and several classmates made contact with the Rebellion on a trip to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine]].<ref name="EGTC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> Biding their time, the cadets played the part of loyal Imperials, loudly applauding a speech given to their graduating class by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]. By the time of their graduation, Biggs and Hobbie's relationship had deteriorated, with Darklighter hoping to be stationed far from his former friend.<ref name="Darklighter8">[[Empire 8|''Empire'' 8]]</ref>

[[File:Biggshobbie.jpg|left|thumb|Darklighter and Klivian arguing on board the ''Rand Ecliptic'']]
Against Darklighter's hopes, he was assigned to be [[First Mate/Legends|first mate]] on the same [[Starship/Legends|ship]] where Klivian was to be [[Second mate/Legends|second mate]], the [[Imperial II-class frigate|''Imperial II''-class frigate]] ''Rand Ecliptic'',<ref name="Darklighter8" /> under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Heliesk]]. Serving dual roles as junior crewmen and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] with the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate's]] [[Twilight Squadron (Imperial)|Twilight Squadron]],<ref name="Darklighter9" /> the two both formed small rebel cells among the crew and made plans to defect to the Rebellion, each unknown to the other. In addition to the groups led by Darklighter and Klivian, there were two other rebel cells aboard the frigate that revealed themselves only after the mutiny had begun.<ref name="Darklighter12" />

During a routine sector patrol, the ''Rand Ecliptic'' met a frigate<ref name="TCSWE" /> that failed to provide proper Imperial identification. Twilight Squadron, led by Darklighter, was deployed to engage the ship, and ordered to destroy the suspected Rebel vessel, or disable it so that the ''Ecliptic''{{'s}} crew could interrogate the passengers. Darklighter directed his [[TIE pilot]]s to safely disable the frigate, which identified itself as the ''[[Lark]]'', a vessel belonging to the [[Camblian Order]] of [[Eedoq]] ferrying [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] to the [[Clarion Scholars Academy]] on [[Daemen]]. Against Darklighter's orders, one of the pilots, [[Tars Nandy]], fired a shot that destroyed the ship. Although Klivian witnessed Nandy's actions, Darklighter was unable to find the perpetrator, and Captain Heliesk dismissed the massacre, noting that it would save them days of interrogation. The apparent indifference from the Captain angered Darklighter, who invited his rebel friends, including [[Peate Kurin]]<ref name="Darklighter12" /> and [[Delund]], to a secret meeting to plan their defection, unwilling to take part in another massacre.<ref name="Darklighter9" />

==The mutiny==
{{Quote|You really forced my hand, ''Darklighter''. If you'd just let me get a word out before trying to slit my throat, you would've learned yours wasn't the ''only'' rebel cell on the ''Rand Ecliptic''.|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian to Biggs Darklighter|<ref name="Darklighter12" />}}
While on his way to the meeting's concealed location, Darklighter encountered Klivian in a passageway. Suspicious of each other, Darklighter waited for Klivian to pass before opening the meeting room's access panel, while Klivian returned to investigate, eavesdropping on the rebel cell. Despite their distance from sanctuary and the limited [[Life support/Legends|life support]] capacity of their TIE fighters, their complicity in the destruction of the ''Lark'' pressed the rebels into action: they had just resolved to jump ship at the next opportunity when they noticed Klivian's shadow outside the hidden compartment. Unaware of the second mate's rebel sympathies, Darklighter's group seized Klivian, attempting to kill him before he could reveal his discovery.
Klivian detonated a [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenade]], giving him a chance to escape and beginning the mutiny on the ''Rand Ecliptic''.<ref name="Darklighter9" />

[[File:Klivian_arm.jpg|thumb|Darklighter and Klivian talking about the mutiny afterward]]
As the effects of the grenade wore off, Darklighter and his friends sabotaged the frigate's systems, doing as much damage as they could to cover their escape in TIE fighters stolen from the hangar, heading [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] north to rendezvous.<ref name="Darklighter9" /> Meanwhile, taking advantage of Darklighter's disruption, Klivian led his cell in taking command of the ''Rand Ecliptic'', discovering the frigate's other rebel cells and losing his left arm, among other injuries, in the process. The rebel mutineers allowed a group of Imperial loyalists in the crew to flee in the frigate's remaining TIE fighters, with the exception of Tars Nandy, who Klivian detained<ref name="TCSWE" /> for his massacre of the ''Lark'', and Captain Heliesk, who was extracted from his quarters for his knowledge of Imperial communications codes.<ref name="Darklighter12" /> In reality, Heliesk was a Rebel Alliance sympathizer and operative codenamed Starfire, but was unable to reveal his allegiance for fear of breaking his cover.<ref name="TCSWE" />

Searching the [[Sululluub]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] without success for a safe harbor, Darklighter and his companions, running out of air and fuel in their fighters, made the decision to return to the ''Rand Ecliptic'' and steal the supplies they needed. Surprised at the lack of resistance, the rebels discovered that the ship had changed allegiance during their absence. After learning about the events on board the ''Rand Ecliptic'' from acting-captain Klivian Darklighter declined to use his higher Imperial rank to take over the ship, saying that Klivian had earned the right to command the ''Rand Ecliptic'' until Rebel Alliance said otherwise, and that he was happy to continue to serve as the first mate.<ref name="Darklighter12" />

Some time after taking command of the frigate, the mutineers were pursued by a group of TIE fighters. With the assistance of [[Lindy]], a friend of Klivian's stationed at Bestine,<ref name="TCSWE" /> Darklighter offloaded the ship's cargo in their pursuers' path, destroying the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and allowing the frigate to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and escape to the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Baron Fel" />

==Aftermath==
After joining the Rebel Alliance and turning over the ''Rand Ecliptic'', Klivian received [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] enhancements, including a prosthetic arm, to repair the injuries he had sustained during the mutiny.<ref name="Darklighter12" /> Stationed at the [[Great Temple/Legends|Rebel base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], a group of defectors including Darklighter, Klivian, Kurin, and Delund formed a starfighter unit called the [[Ecliptic Evaders|''Ecliptic'' Evaders]].<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|pack=Ecliptic Evader TIE Fighter|altlink=https://www.jeditemplearchives.com/content/modules.php?name=JReviews&rop=showcontent&id=241}}</ref> Rebel [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] used the ''Rand Ecliptic'' and the Evaders, flying their captured TIE fighters, to [[Strike at an Incom Corporation facility|steal]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] from an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] assembly facility.<ref name="Darklighter12" />

The mutineers' actions would impact the career of their former tutor at the Prefsbelt Academy, Captain [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]]. When two of his best students defected, ruined a group of TIE fighters along the way, and stole a brand new frigate, Fel fell to disgrace and was sent to the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]] as a punishment.<ref name="Baron Fel" />

Later Klivian told a slightly altered version of the events to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] who was curious to hear stories about his late friend, Biggs Darklighter. Klivian claimed that he and Darklighter had worked together to stage the mutiny, with Captain Heliesk's covert support.<ref name="Story">{{WEGCite|story=Mutiny on the Rand Ecliptic (short story)|book=Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back|stext=Mutiny on the ''Rand Ecliptic''|reprint=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The short story [[Mutiny on the Rand Ecliptic (short story)|''Mutiny on the Rand Ecliptic'']] by [[Michael Stern]] tells a different story about the mutiny than the one presented in the ''[[Star Wars: Empire]]'' story arc, [[Star Wars: Empire: Darklighter|''Darklighter'']].<ref name="Darklighter9" /><ref name="Story" /> Although neither version has been identified as more accurate, this article presents the events of the latter for the sake of clarity.

According the short story's version of events, the mutiny was first suggested by Captain Heliesk to Klivian after a stop at the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] Yard on Bestine to take possession of a consignment of [[rubindum]] ore, during which Klivian intended to defect to a local rebel cell along with Darklighter. As "Starfire", Heliesk was in fact the cell's Alliance contact, and in a ploy to deliver the rubindum to the Rebellion without blowing his cover, arrived with a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] escort to "arrest" the cell's members, including Klivian's friend Lindy, and ordered Klivian and Darklighter to bring them aboard the ''Rand Ecliptic''. Dropping the word "Starfire" into the conversation and a [[Code cylinder/Legends|rank cylinder]] into Klivian's hand, the Captain met Darklighter and Klivian in private, and instructed the rebels to stage a mutiny to help him protect his status as a valuable spy for his influential station in the Empire and to deliver their cargo of ore to the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Story" />

The mutineers threatened to activate the ship's self-destruct to force the Imperial crew to abandon ship, and with Lindy's rebels manning the bridge, took the ''Rand Ecliptic'' off planet. Although the Imperial Navy Yard launched its complement of TIE fighters in pursuit, Darklighter's dumping of half of the consignment of ore created a small-scale asteroid field in their path, allowing the frigate, its cargo, and its rebel crew to reach the Alliance without exposing Heliesk's involvement.<ref name="Story" />

A cut scene from [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] that was later used in the [[Star Wars (radio)|''A New Hope'' radio dramatization]], [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''A New Hope'' novelization]] and Marvel [[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars #1'']] established that Biggs joined the Rebellion after the capture of the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] at the beginning of ''Episode IV''.<ref name="ANHr">[[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]</ref><ref name="ANHn">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars'' Episode IV: ''A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref><ref name="SW1">[[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]]</ref> However, in ''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]'' it is stated that Biggs participated in the Rebel Alliance's theft of the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]], which occurred prior to the events on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="OSG">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref> Years later, the comic story ''Star Wars: Empire: Darklighter'' revealed that Biggs had already joined the Rebellion, and kept the whole truth from Luke in an attempt to protect him.<ref name="Darklighter8" />
